<?xml version="1.0" encoding="windows-1250"?>
<string_table>
<string id="st_hf_holding_msg">
	<text>$key_interact - Umisteni objektu\n
        \n
        $key_collision - Prepnuti detekce kolize\n
        $key_align - Prepnutí zaroveni povrchu\n
        \n
        $key_mode - Prepnuti do pokrocileho rezimu\n
        ESCAPE - Zruseni umisteni\n
    </text>
</string>

<string id="st_hf_advanced_msg">
	<text>$key_interact - Umisteni objektu\n
        \n
        Transformace:\n
        MOUSE1 - Pohyb ve vodorovne rovine\n
        MOUSE2 - Otaceni kolem svisle osy\n
        LSHIFT + MOUSE1 - Pohyb podle svisle osy\n
        \n
        Modifikatory:\n
        LALT - Prichyceni\n
        LCTRL - Doladeni ovladani\n
        \n
        $key_mode - Prepnuti do rezimu nahledu\n
        ESCAPE - prepnuti do normalniho rezimu\n
    </text>
</string>

<string id="st_hf_preview_msg">
	<text>$key_interact - Umisteni objektu\n
        \n
        ESCAPE - Zruseni umisteni\n
        $key_mode - Prepnuti do pokrocileho rezimu
    </text>
</string>



</string_table>
s:
$key_interact - Umisteni objektu

        

        $key_collision - Prepnuti detekce kolize

        $key_align - Prepnutí zaroveni povrchu

        

        $key_mode - Prepnuti do pokrocileho rezimu

        ESCAPE - Zruseni umisteni

$key_interact - Place Object

            

            $key_collision - Toggle Collision Detection

            $key_align - Toggle Surface Alignment

            

            $key_mode - Switch to Advanced Mode

            ESCAPE - Cancel Placement

$key_interact - Umisteni objektu

        

        Transformace:

        MOUSE1 - Pohyb ve vodorovne rovine

        MOUSE2 - Otaceni kolem svisle osy

        LSHIFT + MOUSE1 - Pohyb podle svisle osy

        

        Modifikatory:

        LALT - Prichyceni

        LCTRL - Doladeni ovladani

        

        $key_mode - Prepnuti do rezimu nahledu

        ESCAPE - prepnuti do normalniho rezimu

$key_interact - Place Object

            

            Transforms:

            MOUSE1 - Move on Horizontal Plane

            MOUSE2 - Rotate about Vertical Axis

            LSHIFT + MOUSE1 - Move along Vertical Axis

            

            Modifiers:

            LALT - Snap

            LCTRL - Finetune Control

            

            $key_mode - Switch to Preview Mode

            ESCAPE - Switch to Normal Mode

$key_interact - Umisteni objektu\n
        \n
        ESCAPE - Zruseni umisteni\n
        $key_mode - Prepnuti do pokrocileho rezimu

$key_interact - Place Object\n
            \n
            ESCAPE - Cancel Placement\n
            $key_mode - Switch to Advanced Mode
